monitoring.title: Scorecard monitoring
monitoring.subtitle: How each scorecard version is scoring and performing. Figures are recomputed on every load.
monitoring.explain: As of {asOf}. A loan counts as bad when it reached {dpd}+ days past due within {months} months of disbursement; only loans disbursed at least that long ago (mature) count towards bad rates, Gini, AUC and KS. Stability compares the grade mix of applications scored {baselineFrom} – {baselineTo} (baseline) with {recentFrom} – {recentTo} (recent). Challenger rows are shadow evaluations: they are scored alongside the champion but never affect a decision, so their approval figures reflect the champion’s decisions.

LendingPages.workflows: Origination workflows: optional checks and amount-based approval levels.

LendingPages.auditTrail: Every lending action and policy decision, with the configuration versions in force at the time.

Overview.legacyModuleOnlyBody: This screen reads loans made in the original loans module. Loans in the lending platform — the main book — are not included here.
Overview.fxNote: A rate takes effect as soon as it is saved; there is no second-person approval. Reports convert amounts with the latest rate on or before their date. Lending approval limits set in another currency use only a recent rate; if a limit is refused because the rate is missing or stale, record a current rate here.
Overview.provisionBasis: Days past due are counted to the business date. A run posts to the ledger immediately; it is not reviewed by a second person.
Overview.provisionRunDone: Provisioning run complete as of {date}: {total} across {loans} loans.
Overview.mixedCurrencyNote: Amounts here are added up as recorded and are not converted between currencies; if you lend in more than one currency, use Reports, which converts with your FX rates.

workflow.currencyInvalid: Currency must be * or a 3-letter ISO code
workflow.amountInvalid: From amount must be a decimal
workflow.starAboveZero: A level for every currency (*) must start at 0 — amounts in different currencies are not comparable. Give a threshold above 0 a currency.
workflow.levelsHelp: Each level applies from its amount upwards in its currency; the highest matching level decides how many approvers are needed. * applies to every currency and only from 0.
workflow.cpExplain: Conditions precedent come from the product configuration and are always checked before disbursement, so this step cannot be switched off.
